title: Ventilation, MVHR & FCUs
activity: Ductwork, fire dampers, MVHR units, FCUs and grilles
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Ductwork supported rigidly at even centres, joints sealed?
Insulation complete with no gaps or damage?
Flexible connections to grilles not crushed or over-long?
Open ends blanked/taped, no debris in the ducts?
Fire dampers/sleeves fitted at fire walls, damper drop-tested and reset, access to it?
questions.source: Borough apartment ITP (BRS-05) – fire damper 2.4–2.9; ductwork 2.17–2.20

questions.q: MVHR the right handing, fixed to a solid element?
Filters fitted and the unit accessible for maintenance (access panel lines up)?
FCU in position, right handing, AV mounts freed from transit bolts?
Condensate drain connected and falling – water poured in runs to drain?
questions.source: Borough apartment ITP (BRS-05) – FCU 2.8; drain test 2.2

questions.q: Access panel lines up with the FCU, filter can physically be removed?
Flow/return connected and tested, drain cocks and air vents fitted?
Grilles in the RCP positions, level, clean and undamaged?
